title: Evaluation after changing the available set
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets of coordinates with $A=B$, and let $T$ be a binary decision tree on $A$. For every input in the $n$-dimensional binary cube, regarding $T$ as a tree on $B$ by this equality gives the same output as evaluating $T$ on that input.
